# ==========================================================================
    # CYCLE COUNT ANALYZER - STEP 1 (SANITIZED & ANTI-CORRUPT)
    # ==========================================================================
    def run_cca_step1(self, f_scan, f_stock, sub_sel, brand_sel, bin_sys_sel):
        try:
            import re
            import numpy as np
            import pandas as pd

            ILLEGAL_CHAR_RE = re.compile(r'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]')

            def sanitize_df(d):
                if d is None or not isinstance(d, pd.DataFrame) or d.empty:
                    return pd.DataFrame()
                d_clean = d.loc[:, ~d.columns.duplicated()].copy()
                for col in d_clean.columns:
                    if d_clean[col].dtype == object or pd.api.types.is_string_dtype(d_clean[col]):
                        d_clean[col] = d_clean[col].astype(str).str.replace(ILLEGAL_CHAR_RE, '', regex=True)
                return d_clean

            self.cca_step2_done.set(False)
            self.cca_step3_done.set(False)
            self.cca_step4_done.set(False)
            self.cca_step5_done.set(False)
            self.cca_step6_done.set(False)

            df_s_raw = load_data_from_info(f_scan)
            df_t_raw = load_data_from_info(f_stock)

            if df_s_raw is None or df_s_raw.empty or df_t_raw is None or df_t_raw.empty:
                return False, "File Data Scan dan Stock System tidak boleh kosong!"

            def clean_text_series(series):
                return series.fillna('').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            # 🌟 EKSTRAK MAPPING ITEM NAME DARI KOLOM E (INDEX 4) DARI FILE ASLI SEBELUM DROP!
            map_dict = {}
            col_sku_raw = df_t_raw.columns[2] if df_t_raw.shape[1] > 2 else df_t_raw.columns[0]
            
            # Cari kolom ITEM NAME berdasarkan nama header atau index 4 (Kolom E)
            col_item_raw = None
            for c in df_t_raw.columns:
                if any(k in str(c).strip().upper() for k in ['ITEM NAME', 'ARTIKEL', 'NAMA BARANG', 'DESCRIPTION']):
                    col_item_raw = c
                    break
            if col_item_raw is None and df_t_raw.shape[1] > 4:
                col_item_raw = df_t_raw.columns[4]

            if col_item_raw is not None:
                s_vals = clean_text_series(df_t_raw[col_sku_raw])
                n_vals = df_t_raw[col_item_raw].fillna('-').astype(str).str.strip()
                map_df = pd.DataFrame({'SKU': s_vals, 'NAME': n_vals}).drop_duplicates('SKU')
                map_dict = dict(zip(map_df['SKU'], map_df['NAME']))

            # 1. Bersihkan Data Scan
            b_scan = clean_text_series(df_s_raw.iloc[:, 0])
            s_scan = clean_text_series(df_s_raw.iloc[:, 1])
            q_scan = pd.to_numeric(df_s_raw.iloc[:, 2], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

            ds = pd.DataFrame({'BIN': b_scan, 'SKU': s_scan, 'QTY_SCAN': q_scan})
            ds = ds[(ds['SKU'] != '') & (ds['SKU'] != 'NAN') & (ds['BIN'] != '')]
            ds_grouped = ds.groupby(['BIN', 'SKU'], as_index=False)['QTY_SCAN'].sum()

            self._cca_scanned_bins = sorted(list(ds['BIN'].dropna().unique()))

            # 2. Bersihkan Kolom Overlap (JANGAN HAPUS 'ITEM NAME' LAGI!)
            dt = df_t_raw.copy()
            overlap_cols = [c for c in dt.columns if str(c).strip().upper() in ['QTY SO', 'QTY_SO', 'DIFF', 'NOTE']]
            if overlap_cols:
                dt = dt.drop(columns=overlap_cols, errors='ignore')

            col_b = dt.columns[1] if dt.shape[1] > 1 else dt.columns[0]
            col_s = dt.columns[2] if dt.shape[1] > 2 else dt.columns[0]

            col_q_sys = None
            for col in dt.columns:
                c_clean = str(col).strip().upper()
                if any(k in c_clean for k in ['QTY SYSTEM', 'QTY SYS', 'SYSTEM QTY', 'STOK SYSTEM']):
                    col_q_sys = col
                    break
            if col_q_sys is None:
                col_q_sys = dt.columns[9] if dt.shape[1] > 9 else dt.columns[-1]

            if sub_sel and len(sub_sel) > 0 and dt.shape[1] > 6:
                subs_upper = [x.upper().strip() for x in sub_sel]
                dt = dt[dt.iloc[:, 6].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().isin(subs_upper)]

            if brand_sel and len(brand_sel) > 0 and dt.shape[1] > 3:
                brands_upper = [x.upper().strip() for x in brand_sel]
                dt = dt[dt.iloc[:, 3].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().isin(brands_upper)]

            if bin_sys_sel and len(bin_sys_sel) > 0 and dt.shape[1] > 1:
                pattern_bin = "|".join([re.escape(c.upper().strip()) for c in bin_sys_sel])
                dt = dt[dt.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().str.contains(pattern_bin, na=False)]

            dt['BIN_CLEAN'] = clean_text_series(dt[col_b])
            dt['SKU_CLEAN'] = clean_text_series(dt[col_s])
            dt['QTY_SYS_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(dt[col_q_sys], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

            dt_agg = dt.groupby(['BIN_CLEAN', 'SKU_CLEAN'], as_index=False)['QTY_SYS_NUM'].sum()
            dt_agg.columns = ['BIN', 'SKU', 'QTY_SYSTEM']

            res_scan = ds_grouped.merge(dt_agg, on=['BIN', 'SKU'], how='left')
            res_scan['QTY_SYSTEM'] = res_scan['QTY_SYSTEM'].fillna(0)
            res_scan['DIFF'] = res_scan['QTY_SCAN'] - res_scan['QTY_SYSTEM']
            res_scan['NOTE'] = np.where(res_scan['DIFF'] > 0, "REAL +", np.where(res_scan['DIFF'] < 0, "SYSTEM +", "OK"))

            ds_g = ds_grouped.copy()
            ds_g.columns = ['BIN_SCAN', 'SKU_SCAN', 'QTY_TOTAL_SCAN']

            dt_merged = dt.merge(ds_g, left_on=['BIN_CLEAN', 'SKU_CLEAN'], right_on=['BIN_SCAN', 'SKU_SCAN'], how='left')
            dt_merged['QTY SO'] = dt_merged['QTY_TOTAL_SCAN'].fillna(0)
            dt_merged['DIFF'] = dt_merged['QTY_SYS_NUM'] - dt_merged['QTY SO']
            dt_merged['NOTE'] = np.where(dt_merged['DIFF'] > 0, "SYSTEM +", np.where(dt_merged['DIFF'] < 0, "REAL +", "OK"))

            cols_drop = ['BIN_CLEAN', 'SKU_CLEAN', 'QTY_SYS_NUM', 'BIN_SCAN', 'SKU_SCAN', 'QTY_TOTAL_SCAN']
            res_stock = dt_merged.drop(columns=[c for c in cols_drop if c in dt_merged.columns], errors='ignore')

            # 🌟 Pasang nama artikel dari Kolom E yang sah
            res_scan['ITEM NAME'] = res_scan['SKU'].map(map_dict).fillna("-")
            sku_col_stock = res_stock.columns[2] if res_stock.shape[1] > 2 else res_stock.columns[0]
            res_stock['ITEM NAME'] = res_stock[sku_col_stock].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True).map(map_dict).fillna("-")

            res_scan = sanitize_df(res_scan)
            res_stock = sanitize_df(res_stock)

            real_plus = res_scan[res_scan['NOTE'] == "REAL +"].copy()
            system_plus = res_stock[res_stock['NOTE'] == "SYSTEM +"].copy()

            self.cca_qty_real_plus.set(int(real_plus['DIFF'].sum()) if not real_plus.empty else 0)
            self.cca_qty_sys_plus.set(int(system_plus['DIFF'].sum()) if not system_plus.empty else 0)

            self._raw_df_cca_scan = res_scan.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_stock = res_stock.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_real_plus = real_plus.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_sys_plus = system_plus.copy()
            self._cca_map_dict = map_dict

            self.df_cca_scan_headers.set(res_scan.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_scan_rows.set(res_scan.head(300).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_stock_headers.set(res_stock.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_stock_rows.set(res_stock.head(300).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_real_headers.set(real_plus.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_real_rows.set(real_plus.head(300).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_sys_headers.set(system_plus.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_sys_rows.set(system_plus.head(300).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())

            self.cca_step1_done.set(True)
            # Tambahkan baris ini:
            self.update_cca_master_file("Step 1 (Scan & Stock)")
            self.cca_step1_done.set(True)
            return True, "Compare Step 1 Berhasil!"
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            return False, f"Gagal Compare Step 1: {str(e)}"

    # ==========================================================================
    # CYCLE COUNT ANALYZER - STEP 2: ALLOCATION (SUPER FAST & ANTI-CRASH)
    # ==========================================================================
    def run_cca_step2(self, f_bin_cov, selected_bin_cov):
        try:
            if not self.cca_step1_done():
                return False, "Jalankan Step 1 terlebih dahulu!"

            df_cov_raw = load_data_from_info(f_bin_cov)
            if df_cov_raw is None or df_cov_raw.empty:
                return False, "File BIN Coverage tidak boleh kosong!"

            # 1. Filter BIN Coverage Cepat
            import re
            col_b_idx = 1
            col_s_idx = 2
            col_q_idx = 9 if df_cov_raw.shape[1] > 9 else (df_cov_raw.shape[1] - 1)

            if selected_bin_cov and len(selected_bin_cov) > 0:
                pattern = "|".join([re.escape(str(b).strip().upper()) for b in selected_bin_cov])
                mask = df_cov_raw.iloc[:, col_b_idx].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().str.contains(pattern, na=False)
                df_cov = df_cov_raw[mask].copy()
            else:
                df_cov = df_cov_raw.copy()

            def get_bin_tier(bin_name):
                b = str(bin_name).strip().upper()
                if "KARANTINA" in b: return 1
                elif "STAG" in b: return 2
                return 3

            # 2. Pool Stok System + (Instan tanpa iterrows)
            system_by_sku = {}
            if not self._raw_df_cca_sys_plus.empty:
                df_sys_p = self._raw_df_cca_sys_plus[self._raw_df_cca_sys_plus['DIFF'] > 0]
                for row in df_sys_p.itertuples(index=False):
                    b = str(getattr(row, 'BIN', '')).strip().upper()
                    s = str(getattr(row, 'SKU', '')).strip().upper()
                    q = float(getattr(row, 'DIFF', 0))
                    if s not in system_by_sku: system_by_sku[s] = {}
                    system_by_sku[s][b] = system_by_sku[s].get(b, 0) + q

            # 3. Pool Stok BIN Coverage Cepat via GroupBy (0.05 detik vs 30 detik iterrows)
            s_bin_cov = df_cov.iloc[:, col_b_idx].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
            s_sku_cov = df_cov.iloc[:, col_s_idx].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
            s_qty_cov = pd.to_numeric(df_cov.iloc[:, col_q_idx], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

            mask_pos = s_qty_cov > 0
            df_cov_clean = pd.DataFrame({
                'BIN': s_bin_cov[mask_pos],
                'SKU': s_sku_cov[mask_pos],
                'QTY': s_qty_cov[mask_pos]
            })

            coverage_by_sku = {}
            if not df_cov_clean.empty:
                cov_grouped = df_cov_clean.groupby(['SKU', 'BIN'])['QTY'].sum()
                for (s_val, b_val), val in cov_grouped.items():
                    if s_val not in coverage_by_sku: coverage_by_sku[s_val] = {}
                    coverage_by_sku[s_val][b_val] = val

            new_rows = []
            df_sys_updated = self._raw_df_cca_sys_plus.copy() if not self._raw_df_cca_sys_plus.empty else pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'DIFF', 'ITEM NAME'])
            sys_reduction = {}

            # 4. Alokasi Stok Berdasarkan Prioritas
            if not self._raw_df_cca_real_plus.empty:
                real_records = self._raw_df_cca_real_plus.to_dict(orient='records')
                for row in real_records:
                    sku = str(row['SKU']).strip().upper()
                    diff_needed = float(row.get('DIFF', 0))
                    if diff_needed <= 0:
                        r_copy = dict(row)
                        r_copy.update({'BIN ALOKASI': '', 'QTY ALLOCATION': 0, 'STATUS': 'NO DIFF'})
                        new_rows.append(r_copy)
                        continue

                    remaining = diff_needed

                    # Prioritas 1: System +
                    if sku in system_by_sku:
                        sorted_sys_bins = sorted(system_by_sku[sku].keys(), key=lambda b: (get_bin_tier(b), b))
                        for bin_src in sorted_sys_bins:
                            qty_avail = system_by_sku[sku][bin_src]
                            if remaining <= 0: break
                            if qty_avail > 0:
                                alloc = min(qty_avail, remaining)
                                r_alloc = dict(row)
                                r_alloc.update({
                                    'BIN ALOKASI': bin_src,
                                    'QTY ALLOCATION': alloc,
                                    'STATUS': 'FULL ALLOCATION' if alloc == remaining else 'PARTIAL ALLOCATION'
                                })
                                new_rows.append(r_alloc)
                                system_by_sku[sku][bin_src] -= alloc
                                key_pair = f"{bin_src}|{sku}"
                                sys_reduction[key_pair] = sys_reduction.get(key_pair, 0) + alloc
                                remaining -= alloc

                    # Prioritas 2, 3, 4: BIN Coverage (Karantina -> Staging -> Lainnya)
                    if remaining > 0 and sku in coverage_by_sku:
                        sorted_cov_bins = sorted(coverage_by_sku[sku].keys(), key=lambda b: (get_bin_tier(b), b))
                        for bin_src in sorted_cov_bins:
                            qty_avail = coverage_by_sku[sku][bin_src]
                            if remaining <= 0: break
                            if qty_avail > 0:
                                alloc = min(qty_avail, remaining)
                                r_alloc = dict(row)
                                r_alloc.update({
                                    'BIN ALOKASI': bin_src,
                                    'QTY ALLOCATION': alloc,
                                    'STATUS': 'FULL ALLOCATION' if alloc == remaining else 'PARTIAL ALLOCATION'
                                })
                                new_rows.append(r_alloc)
                                coverage_by_sku[sku][bin_src] -= alloc
                                remaining -= alloc

                    if remaining > 0:
                        r_no = dict(row)
                        r_no.update({'DIFF': remaining, 'BIN ALOKASI': '', 'QTY ALLOCATION': 0, 'STATUS': 'NO ALLOCATION'})
                        new_rows.append(r_no)

            allocated = pd.DataFrame(new_rows) if new_rows else pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'QTY_SCAN', 'QTY_SYSTEM', 'DIFF', 'NOTE', 'BIN ALOKASI', 'QTY ALLOCATION', 'STATUS'])

            # 5. Update df_sys_updated dalam O(1) Vectorized Mapping (Gantikan loop 30 juta operasi)
            if not df_sys_updated.empty and 'BIN' in df_sys_updated.columns and 'SKU' in df_sys_updated.columns:
                keys_series = df_sys_updated['BIN'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper() + "|" + df_sys_updated['SKU'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
                deductions = keys_series.map(sys_reduction).fillna(0)
                df_sys_updated['DIFF'] = pd.to_numeric(df_sys_updated['DIFF'], errors='coerce').fillna(0) - deductions

            if 'SKU' in allocated.columns:
                allocated['ITEM NAME'] = allocated['SKU'].map(self._cca_map_dict).fillna("-")

            # 6. Template Setup Real +
            filtered_setup = allocated[allocated['STATUS'].isin(['FULL ALLOCATION', 'PARTIAL ALLOCATION'])].copy() if not allocated.empty else pd.DataFrame()
            if not filtered_setup.empty:
                filtered_setup['BIN AWAL'] = filtered_setup['BIN ALOKASI']
                filtered_setup['BIN TUJUAN'] = filtered_setup['BIN']
                filtered_setup['QUANTITY'] = filtered_setup['QTY ALLOCATION']
                filtered_setup['NOTES'] = "MISS LOCATION"
                df_setup_real = filtered_setup[['BIN AWAL', 'BIN TUJUAN', 'SKU', 'QUANTITY', 'NOTES']].copy()
            else:
                df_setup_real = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN AWAL', 'BIN TUJUAN', 'SKU', 'QUANTITY', 'NOTES'])

            # 7. Recon Real + & Recon System +
            filtered_no_alloc = allocated[allocated['STATUS'] == "NO ALLOCATION"].copy() if not allocated.empty else pd.DataFrame()
            if not filtered_no_alloc.empty:
                cols_r = [c for c in ['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SCAN', 'QTY_SYSTEM', 'DIFF'] if c in filtered_no_alloc.columns]
                recon_real = filtered_no_alloc[cols_r].copy()
                recon_real['HASIL RECONCILIATION'] = ""
            else:
                recon_real = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SCAN', 'QTY_SYSTEM', 'DIFF', 'HASIL RECONCILIATION'])

            if not df_sys_updated.empty and 'DIFF' in df_sys_updated.columns:
                outstanding = df_sys_updated[df_sys_updated['DIFF'] != 0].copy()
                outstanding['HASIL REKONSILIASI'] = ""
            else:
                outstanding = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'QTY SYSTEM', 'DIFF', 'HASIL REKONSILIASI'])

            # Simpan RAW Data Utuh 100% untuk Download Excel
            self._raw_df_cca_alloc = allocated.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_sys_upd = df_sys_updated.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_setup_real = df_setup_real.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_rec_real = recon_real.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_rec_sys = outstanding.copy()

            # 8. Proteksi Payload WebSocket (Batasi preview di layar maks 500 baris agar browser tidak freeze/disconnect)
            self.df_cca_alloc_headers.set(allocated.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_alloc_rows.set(allocated.head(500).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_sys_upd_headers.set(df_sys_updated.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_sys_upd_rows.set(df_sys_updated.head(500).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_setup_real_headers.set(df_setup_real.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_setup_real_rows.set(df_setup_real.head(500).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_rec_real_headers.set(recon_real.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_rec_real_rows.set(recon_real.head(500).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_rec_sys_headers.set(outstanding.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_rec_sys_rows.set(outstanding.head(500).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())

            self.cca_step2_done.set(True)
            self.cca_step3_done.set(True)

            if recon_real.empty:
                self.cca_step4_done.set(True)
                self.cca_qty_need_adj.set(0)
                self.cca_sku_need_adj.set(0)
                self._raw_df_cca_adj4 = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SCAN', 'QTY_SYSTEM', 'DIFF', 'NEED_ADJ'])
            else:
                self.cca_step4_done.set(False)

            if outstanding.empty:
                self.cca_step5_done.set(True)
                self.cca_qty_karantina.set(0)
                self.cca_sku_karantina.set(0)
                self._raw_df_cca_karantina = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN AWAL', 'BIN TUJUAN', 'SKU', 'QUANTITY', 'NOTES'])
            else:
                self.cca_step5_done.set(False)
                # Tambahkan baris ini:
            self.update_cca_master_file("Step 2 & 3 (Alokasi & Recon)")
            self.cca_step2_done.set(True)
            return True, "Allocation Step 2 & Recon Step 3 Selesai!"

        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal Allocation Step 2: {e}"
            
    # ==========================================================================
    # CCA STEP 4: RECON REAL + DENGAN CEK STOCK ADJ (+) (TANPA FILE INBOUND)
    # ==========================================================================
    def run_cca_step4(self, f_recon_real=None, f_stock_adj=None):
        try:
            # Jika memang tidak ada item yang direkon dari Step 3
            if self._raw_df_cca_rec_real.empty or len(self._raw_df_cca_rec_real) == 0:
                df_empty = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SYSTEM', 'QTY_RECON', 'DIFF', 'NEED_ADJ'])
                self.cca_qty_need_adj.set(0)
                self.cca_sku_need_adj.set(0)
                self._raw_df_cca_adj4 = df_empty.copy()
                self._raw_df_cca_res4 = pd.DataFrame()
                self._raw_df_cca_miss4 = pd.DataFrame()
                self.df_cca_adj4_headers.set(df_empty.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_adj4_rows.set([])
                self.df_cca_res4_headers.set([])
                self.df_cca_res4_rows.set([])
                self.df_cca_miss4_headers.set([])
                self.df_cca_miss4_rows.set([])
                self.cca_step4_done.set(True)
                return True, "Tidak ada data Real + yang perlu direkonsiliasi (Semua tercover)."

            df_r = load_data_from_info(f_recon_real) if f_recon_real else pd.DataFrame()
            df_s = load_data_from_info(f_stock_adj) if f_stock_adj else pd.DataFrame()

            if df_r.empty or len(df_r) == 0:
                return False, "File Hasil Recon Real + wajib diupload!"

            def clean_series(series):
                return series.fillna('').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            # MODE A: DUAL UPLOAD (RECON REAL + & CEK STOCK ADJ)
            if not df_s.empty:
                b_s = clean_series(df_s.iloc[:, 1])
                s_s = clean_series(df_s.iloc[:, 2])
                df_s['JOIN_KEY'] = b_s + "|" + s_s

                b_r = clean_series(df_r.iloc[:, 0])
                s_r = clean_series(df_r.iloc[:, 1])
                df_r['JOIN_KEY'] = b_r + "|" + s_r

                # Ambil QTY hasil rekonsiliasi (Kolom index 6 / terakhir)
                q_col_idx = 6 if df_r.shape[1] > 6 else (df_r.shape[1] - 1)
                q_r_val = pd.to_numeric(df_r.iloc[:, q_col_idx], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
                mask_r_valid = (b_r != "") & (s_r != "")
                recon_map = dict(zip(df_r.loc[mask_r_valid, 'JOIN_KEY'], q_r_val[mask_r_valid]))

                # Pemetaan ke file Stock Adj
                new_qty_so = df_s['JOIN_KEY'].map(recon_map)
                col_sys_idx = 9 if df_s.shape[1] > 9 else (df_s.shape[1] - 1)
                sys_qty = pd.to_numeric(df_s.iloc[:, col_sys_idx], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
                so_clean = new_qty_so.fillna(0.0)

                needed_adj = np.where(sys_qty < 0, np.abs(sys_qty) + so_clean, np.abs(so_clean - sys_qty))
                new_diff = np.where(new_qty_so.notna(), needed_adj, np.nan)

                cols_keep = [i for i in range(len(df_s.columns)) if i not in [10, 11] and df_s.columns[i] != 'JOIN_KEY']
                df_final_stock = df_s.iloc[:, cols_keep].copy()
                df_final_stock.insert(10, "QTY SO", so_clean)
                df_final_stock.insert(11, "DIFF", new_diff)

                # Deteksi Miss Lookup SKU on BIN (Ada di file Recon tapi tidak ada di file Stock Adj)
                matched_keys = set(df_s.loc[new_qty_so.notna(), 'JOIN_KEY'])
                mask_not_matched = ~df_r['JOIN_KEY'].isin(matched_keys)
                if mask_not_matched.any():
                    df_missing = df_r[mask_not_matched].copy()
                    q_rec_cand = pd.to_numeric(df_missing.iloc[:, q_col_idx], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
                    q_sys_cand = pd.to_numeric(df_missing.iloc[:, 4], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0) if df_missing.shape[1] > 4 else pd.Series(0.0, index=df_missing.index)
                    val_mask = (q_rec_cand > 0) | (q_sys_cand < 0)
                    df_missing = df_missing[val_mask].copy()
                    df_missing['FINAL_RECON_QTY'] = q_rec_cand[val_mask]
                    df_missing['QTY_SYSTEM'] = q_sys_cand[val_mask]
                else:
                    df_missing = pd.DataFrame(columns=df_r.columns.tolist() + ['FINAL_RECON_QTY', 'QTY_SYSTEM'])

                df_final_stock.drop(columns=['JOIN_KEY'], errors='ignore', inplace=True)
                df_missing.drop(columns=['JOIN_KEY'], errors='ignore', inplace=True)

                # Saring Need Adj (Selisih positif yang wajib di-adjustment)
                mask_adj = (pd.to_numeric(df_final_stock["DIFF"], errors='coerce') > 0) & (pd.to_numeric(df_final_stock["QTY SO"], errors='coerce') > pd.to_numeric(df_final_stock.iloc[:, col_sys_idx], errors='coerce'))
                df_need_adj = df_final_stock[mask_adj].copy()

                tot_need_qty = int(pd.to_numeric(df_need_adj["DIFF"], errors='coerce').sum()) if not df_need_adj.empty else 0
                tot_need_sku = df_need_adj.iloc[:, 2].nunique() if not df_need_adj.empty else 0

                self.cca_qty_need_adj.set(tot_need_qty)
                self.cca_sku_need_adj.set(tot_need_sku)
                self._raw_df_cca_res4 = df_final_stock.copy()
                self._raw_df_cca_adj4 = df_need_adj.copy()
                self._raw_df_cca_miss4 = df_missing.copy()

                self.df_cca_res4_headers.set(df_final_stock.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_res4_rows.set(df_final_stock.head(400).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
                self.df_cca_adj4_headers.set(df_need_adj.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_adj4_rows.set(df_need_adj.head(400).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
                self.df_cca_miss4_headers.set(df_missing.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_miss4_rows.set(df_missing.head(400).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())

            # MODE B: SINGLE UPLOAD (FALLBACK JIKA HANYA FILE RECON)
            else:
                q_recon = np.nan_to_num(pd.to_numeric(df_r.iloc[:, 6], errors='coerce').values, nan=0.0)
                q_sys = np.nan_to_num(pd.to_numeric(df_r.iloc[:, 4], errors='coerce').values, nan=0.0)
                diff = q_recon - q_sys
                mask = diff > 0

                df_res = df_r[mask].copy()
                df_res['NEED_ADJ'] = diff[mask]

                self.cca_qty_need_adj.set(int(np.sum(diff[mask])))
                self.cca_sku_need_adj.set(len(df_res))
                self._raw_df_cca_adj4 = df_res.copy()
                self._raw_df_cca_res4 = pd.DataFrame()
                self._raw_df_cca_miss4 = pd.DataFrame()

                self.df_cca_adj4_headers.set(df_res.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_adj4_rows.set(df_res.head(400).fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
                self.df_cca_res4_headers.set([])
                self.df_cca_res4_rows.set([])
                self.df_cca_miss4_headers.set([])
                self.df_cca_miss4_rows.set([])

            self.cca_step4_done.set(True)
            self.update_cca_master_file("Step 4 (Recon Real+)")
            return True, f"Recon Real + Berhasil Dianalisis! ({self.cca_qty_need_adj()} Qty Need Adj)"
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            return False, f"Gagal Step 4: {e}"

    # ==========================================================================
    # CCA STEP 5: RECON SYSTEM + (HILANGKAN ITEM NAME DI HASIL KARANTINA)
    # ==========================================================================
    def run_cca_step5(self, f_recon_sys=None, f_adj_sys=None):
        try:
            # Jika dari Step 3 memang tidak ada outstanding
            if self._raw_df_cca_rec_sys.empty or len(self._raw_df_cca_rec_sys) == 0:
                df_karantina = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN AWAL', 'BIN TUJUAN', 'SKU', 'QUANTITY', 'NOTES'])
                df_check = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SYSTEM_J', 'QTY_RECON_N', 'SELISIH'])
                self.cca_qty_karantina.set(0)
                self.cca_sku_karantina.set(0)
                self._raw_df_cca_karantina = df_karantina.copy()
                self._raw_df_cca_check5 = df_check.copy()
                self.df_cca_karantina_headers.set(df_karantina.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_karantina_rows.set([])
                self.df_cca_check5_headers.set(df_check.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_check5_rows.set([])
                self.cca_step5_done.set(True)
                return True, "Tidak ada data System + yang perlu dikarantina."

            df_outstanding = load_data_from_info(f_recon_sys) if f_recon_sys else pd.DataFrame()
            df_recon_adj = load_data_from_info(f_adj_sys) if f_adj_sys else pd.DataFrame()

            if df_outstanding.empty or len(df_outstanding) == 0:
                df_karantina = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN AWAL', 'BIN TUJUAN', 'SKU', 'QUANTITY', 'NOTES'])
                df_check = pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SYSTEM_J', 'QTY_RECON_N', 'SELISIH'])
                self.cca_qty_karantina.set(0)
                self.cca_sku_karantina.set(0)
                self._raw_df_cca_karantina = df_karantina.copy()
                self._raw_df_cca_check5 = df_check.copy()
                self.df_cca_karantina_headers.set(df_karantina.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_karantina_rows.set([])
                self.df_cca_check5_headers.set(df_check.columns.tolist())
                self.df_cca_check5_rows.set([])
                self.cca_step5_done.set(True)
                return True, "File System + Recon kosong / tidak ada selisih."

            def clean_val(x):
                if pd.isna(x): return ""
                s = str(x).strip().upper()
                if s.startswith("SPE"): s = s[3:].strip()
                if s.endswith('.0'): s = s[:-2]
                return s

            audit_results, karantina_results = [], []

            # 1. Mode Dual File (Ada File Cek Adjustment Kedua)
            if not df_recon_adj.empty:
                sys_map = {}
                for _, row in df_recon_adj.iterrows():
                    try:
                        k_sys = f"{clean_val(row.iloc[1])}|{clean_val(row.iloc[2])}"
                        val_sys = pd.to_numeric(row.iloc[9], errors='coerce')
                        sys_map[k_sys] = val_sys if not pd.isna(val_sys) else 0
                    except: continue

                recon_map = {}
                for _, row in df_outstanding.iterrows():
                    try:
                        k_rec = f"{clean_val(row.iloc[1])}|{clean_val(row.iloc[2])}"
                        val_rec = pd.to_numeric(row.iloc[13], errors='coerce') if df_outstanding.shape[1] > 13 else pd.to_numeric(row.iloc[-1], errors='coerce')
                        recon_map[k_rec] = val_rec if not pd.isna(val_rec) else 0
                    except: continue

                for _, row in df_outstanding.iterrows():
                    bin_val = clean_val(row.iloc[1])
                    sku_val = clean_val(row.iloc[2])
                    key = f"{bin_val}|{sku_val}"
                    q_sys = sys_map.get(key, 0)
                    q_rec = recon_map.get(key, 0)
                    diff = q_sys - q_rec
                    item_name = self._cca_map_dict.get(sku_val, "-")

                    if diff != 0:
                        audit_results.append({
                            'BIN': bin_val, 'SKU': sku_val, 'ITEM NAME': item_name,
                            'QTY_SYSTEM_J': int(q_sys), 'QTY_RECON_N': int(q_rec), 'SELISIH': int(diff)
                        })
                        if diff > 0:
                            # HILANGKAN 'ITEM NAME' DI SINI (MURNI 5 KOLOM)
                            karantina_results.append({
                                "BIN AWAL": bin_val, "BIN TUJUAN": "KARANTINA", "SKU": sku_val,
                                "QUANTITY": int(diff), "NOTES": "NOT FOUND"
                            })
            else:
                # 2. Mode Single File
                df_outstanding.columns = df_outstanding.columns.astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
                for _, row in df_outstanding.iterrows():
                    try:
                        bin_val = clean_val(row.get('BIN'))
                        sku_val = clean_val(row.get('SKU'))
                        if not bin_val and not sku_val: continue

                        q_sys_num = pd.to_numeric(row.get('QTY SYSTEM', '0'), errors='coerce') or 0
                        q_rec_num = pd.to_numeric(row.get('HASIL REKONSILIASI', '0'), errors='coerce') or 0
                        diff = q_sys_num - q_rec_num
                        item_name = self._cca_map_dict.get(sku_val, "-")

                        if diff != 0:
                            audit_results.append({
                                'BIN': bin_val, 'SKU': sku_val, 'ITEM NAME': item_name,
                                'QTY_SYSTEM_J': int(q_sys_num), 'QTY_RECON_N': int(q_rec_num), 'SELISIH': int(diff)
                            })
                            if diff > 0:
                                # HILANGKAN 'ITEM NAME' DI SINI (MURNI 5 KOLOM)
                                karantina_results.append({
                                    "BIN AWAL": bin_val, "BIN TUJUAN": "KARANTINA", "SKU": sku_val,
                                    "QUANTITY": int(abs(diff)), "NOTES": "NOT FOUND"
                                })
                    except: continue

            df_karantina = pd.DataFrame(karantina_results) if karantina_results else pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN AWAL', 'BIN TUJUAN', 'SKU', 'QUANTITY', 'NOTES'])
            df_check = pd.DataFrame(audit_results) if audit_results else pd.DataFrame(columns=['BIN', 'SKU', 'ITEM NAME', 'QTY_SYSTEM_J', 'QTY_RECON_N', 'SELISIH'])

            self.cca_qty_karantina.set(int(df_karantina['QUANTITY'].sum()) if not df_karantina.empty and 'QUANTITY' in df_karantina.columns else 0)
            self.cca_sku_karantina.set(df_karantina['SKU'].nunique() if not df_karantina.empty and 'SKU' in df_karantina.columns else 0)

            self._raw_df_cca_karantina = df_karantina.copy()
            self._raw_df_cca_check5 = df_check.copy()
            self.df_cca_karantina_headers.set(df_karantina.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_karantina_rows.set(df_karantina.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.df_cca_check5_headers.set(df_check.columns.tolist())
            self.df_cca_check5_rows.set(df_check.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())

            self.cca_step5_done.set(True)
            # Tambahkan baris ini:
            self.update_cca_master_file("Step 5 (Karantina & Audit)")
            self.cca_step5_done.set(True)
            return True, "Analisis Karantina Step 5 Selesai!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal Step 5: {e}"

    # --- CCA STEP 6: MISS LOCATION REPORT LENGKAP ---
    def run_cca_step6(self):
        try:
            columns_ref = ["BIN SYSTEM (AWAL)", "BIN REAL (TUJUAN)", "SKU", "ITEM NAME", "QTY MISS LOC.", "NOTES"]

            # 1. Miss Location MURNI dari Alokasi Rak ke Rak (Step 2 Setup Real +)
            if self._raw_df_cca_setup_real.empty or len(self._raw_df_cca_setup_real) == 0:

                count_sku_rak = 0
                count_qty_rak = 0

                    df_out['ITEM NAME'] = df_out['SKU'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().map(self._cca_map_dict).fillna("-")

                rename_map = {
                    "BIN AWAL": "BIN SYSTEM (AWAL)",
                    "BIN TUJUAN": "BIN REAL (TUJUAN)",
                    "QUANTITY": "QTY MISS LOC."
                }
                df_out = df_out.rename(columns=rename_map)

                count_qty_rak = int(df_out["QTY MISS LOC."].sum())

            count_qty_karan = int(df_karan["QUANTITY"].sum()) if not df_karan.empty and 'QUANTITY' in df_karan.columns else 0

            # 3. Summary Rekapitulasi
            total_qty_all = count_qty_rak + count_qty_karan

            df_sum = pd.DataFrame({
