    # METODE: FORM AUDITOR (4 SHEET RESMI SESUAI STANDAR EXTERNAL AUDIT PACK)
    # ==========================================================================
    def process_auditor_upload(self, f_info):
        try:
            df_raw = load_data_from_info(f_info)
            if df_raw.empty or df_raw.shape[1] < 10:
                return False, "File All Data Stock minimal harus 10 kolom (Format Multiple Adjustment Jezpro)!"

            # Mapping Kolom Jezpro:
            # Col 1 (B) = BIN | Col 2 (C) = SKU | Col 3 (D) = BRAND
            # Col 4 (E) = ITEM NAME | Col 6 (G) = SUB KATEGORI 
            # Col 7 (H) = HARGA BELI | Col 9 (J) = QTY SYSTEM
            df_clean = df_raw.copy()
            col_b = df_clean.columns[1]   # BIN
            col_s = df_clean.columns[2]   # SKU
            col_d = df_clean.columns[3]   # BRAND
            col_e = df_clean.columns[4]   # ITEM NAME
            col_g = df_clean.columns[6]   # SUB KATEGORI
            col_h = next((c for c in df_clean.columns if any(k in str(c).upper() for k in ['HARGA BELI', 'BELI', 'COGS'])), df_clean.columns[7]) # HARGA BELI
            col_j = df_clean.columns[9]   # QTY SYSTEM

            df_clean['BIN_CLEAN'] = df_clean[col_b].fillna('').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
            df_clean['SKU_CLEAN'] = df_clean[col_s].fillna('').astype(str).str.split('.').str[0].str.strip().str.upper()
            df_clean['BRAND_CLEAN'] = df_clean[col_d].fillna('UNKNOWN').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
            df_clean['DESC_CLEAN'] = df_clean[col_e].fillna('-').astype(str).str.strip()
            df_clean['CAT_CLEAN'] = df_clean[col_g].fillna('UNKNOWN').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
            df_clean['HARGA_BELI'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean[col_h], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)  # <-- INI YANG SEBELUMNYA HILANG
            df_clean['QTY_SYS'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean[col_j], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

            # Otomatis tentukan UoM: Kategori sepatu/footwear = PAIR, lainnya = PCS
            df_clean['UOM'] = df_clean['CAT_CLEAN'].apply(
                lambda x: "PAIR" if any(k in str(x).upper() for k in ["FOOTWEAR", "SHOES", "SEPATU", "SANDAL"]) else "PCS"
            )

            # 🛑 KECUALIKAN LOKASI BIN YANG MENGANDUNG "KARANTINA"
            df_clean = df_clean[~df_clean['BIN_CLEAN'].str.contains('KARANTINA', case=False, na=False)].copy()

            # Opsi dropdown filter
            brands = sorted([b for b in df_clean['BRAND_CLEAN'].unique() if b not in ['', 'NAN', 'UNKNOWN']])
            subs = sorted([s for s in df_clean['CAT_CLEAN'].unique() if s not in ['', 'NAN', 'UNKNOWN']])
            bins = sorted([bn for bn in df_clean['BIN_CLEAN'].unique() if bn not in ['', 'NAN']])

            self.auditor_list_brand.set(brands)
            self.auditor_list_sub.set(subs)
            self.auditor_list_bin.set(bins)

            self._raw_df_auditor_base = df_clean
            self.apply_auditor_filters([], [], [])
            self.auditor_uploaded.set(True)
            return True, f"File berhasil dimuat! Ditemukan {len(df_clean):,} baris data non-karantina."
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal membaca file: {str(e)}"

    def apply_auditor_filters(self, sel_brand, sel_sub, sel_bin):
        if self._raw_df_auditor_base.empty:
            return

        df = self._raw_df_auditor_base.copy()

        # Filter berdasarkan pilihan dropdown auditor di UI
        if sel_brand and len(sel_brand) > 0:
            df = df[df['BRAND_CLEAN'].isin([x.upper() for x in sel_brand])]
        if sel_sub and len(sel_sub) > 0:
            df = df[df['CAT_CLEAN'].isin([x.upper() for x in sel_sub])]
        if sel_bin and len(sel_bin) > 0:
            df = df[df['BIN_CLEAN'].isin([x.upper() for x in sel_bin])]

        self.auditor_total_bin.set(df['BIN_CLEAN'].nunique() if not df.empty else 0)
        self.auditor_total_sku.set(df['SKU_CLEAN'].nunique() if not df.empty else 0)
        self.auditor_total_qty.set(int(df['QTY_SYS'].sum()) if not df.empty else 0)

        # Susun tabel Stock Count persis seperti Gambar 2
        count_sheet_df = pd.DataFrame({
            "No.": range(1, len(df) + 1),
            "Bin Location": df['BIN_CLEAN'],
            "SKU": df['SKU_CLEAN'],
            "Description": df['DESC_CLEAN'],
            "Category": df['CAT_CLEAN'],
            "UoM (PAIR / PCS)": df['UOM'],

            "Physical Count": "",

    def update_auditor_counter(self, name: str):
        c_name = name.strip() if name else "Counter A"
        self.auditor_counter.set(c_name)
        if not self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.empty and 'Counter' in self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.columns:
            self._raw_df_auditor_filtered['Counter'] = c_name
            self.df_auditor_rows.set(self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())

    def update_single_count_row(self, row_index: int, phys_val: str, verified: str, remarks: str):
        try:
            if not self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.empty and 0 <= row_index < len(self._raw_df_auditor_filtered):
                p_int = safe_int(phys_val, 0) if str(phys_val).strip() != "" else ""
                sys_qty = safe_int(self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.iloc[row_index]['Qty System'], 0)
                harga_beli = safe_int(self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.iloc[row_index].get('Harga Beli', 0), 0)

                # Variance Value = Selisih QTY x Harga Beli
                var_val = ((p_int - sys_qty) * harga_beli) if p_int != "" else ""

                self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.at[row_index, 'Physical Count'] = p_int
                self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.at[row_index, 'Variance Value'] = var_val
                self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.at[row_index, 'Auditor Verified'] = verified
                self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.at[row_index, 'Remarks'] = remarks

                self.df_auditor_rows.set(self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
                self._recalc_auditor_totals()
                return True, "Data baris berhasil diperbarui!"
            return False, "Indeks baris tidak ditemukan!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, str(e)

    def _recalc_auditor_totals(self):
        if not self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.empty:
            df = self._raw_df_auditor_filtered
            tot_p = sum([safe_int(x, 0) for x in df['Physical Count'] if str(x).strip() != ''])
            tot_v = sum([safe_int(x, 0) for x in df['Variance Value'] if str(x).strip() != ''])
            self.auditor_total_phys.set(tot_p)
            self.auditor_total_var.set(tot_v)

    def import_filled_count_sheet(self, file_info):
        """Mengunggah file Excel hasil download yang sudah diisi auditor"""
        try:
            df_in = load_data_from_info(file_info)
            if df_in.empty or df_in.shape[1] < 8:
                return False, "File tidak valid atau format kolom kurang!"

            df_base = self._raw_df_auditor_filtered.copy()
            if df_base.empty:
                return False, "Data master count sheet kosong. Muat file stock terlebih dahulu!"

            df_in_cols = [str(c).strip().upper() for c in df_in.columns]

            def find_col(kw, default_idx):
                for idx, c in enumerate(df_in_cols):
                    if any(k in c for k in kw): return idx
                return default_idx

            c_bin = find_col(['BIN', 'LOCATION'], 1)
            c_sku = find_col(['SKU', 'ITEM'], 2)
            c_phys = find_col(['PHYSICAL', 'ACTUAL', 'COUNT'], 7)
            c_ver = find_col(['VERIFIED', 'AUDITOR'], 10)
            c_rem = find_col(['REMARKS', 'NOTE'], 11)

            fill_map = {}
            for _, r in df_in.iterrows():
                b = str(r.iloc[c_bin]).strip().upper()
                s = str(r.iloc[c_sku]).split('.')[0].strip().upper()
                p = r.iloc[c_phys]
                v = str(r.iloc[c_ver]).strip() if df_in.shape[1] > c_ver else "Yes"
                rem = str(r.iloc[c_rem]).strip() if df_in.shape[1] > c_rem else ""
                fill_map[(b, s)] = (p, v, rem)

            updated_cnt = 0
            for idx, r in df_base.iterrows():
                b_curr = str(r['Bin Location']).strip().upper()
                s_curr = str(r['SKU']).strip().upper()
                if (b_curr, s_curr) in fill_map:
                    p_val, v_val, rem_val = fill_map[(b_curr, s_curr)]
                    p_int = safe_int(p_val, 0)
                    sys_qty = safe_int(r['Qty System'], 0)
                    df_base.at[idx, 'Physical Count'] = p_int
                    df_base.at[idx, 'Variance Value'] = p_int - sys_qty
                    df_base.at[idx, 'Auditor Verified'] = v_val if v_val else "Yes"
                    df_base.at[idx, 'Remarks'] = rem_val
                    updated_cnt += 1

            self._raw_df_auditor_filtered = df_base
            self.df_auditor_rows.set(df_base.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self._recalc_auditor_totals()
            return True, f"Berhasil sinkronisasi {updated_cnt} baris Physical Count ke Tab 2!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal membaca file count sheet: {str(e)}"

    def toggle_audit_finding_status(self, audit_id: str, finding_idx: int):
        """Mengubah status finding (Open <-> Closed) dan menyimpannya ke Supabase"""
        try:
            histories = list(self.auditor_history_list())
            target_hist = next((h for h in histories if h.get("id") == audit_id), None)
            if not target_hist:
                return False, "Sesi audit tidak ditemukan!"

            findings = list(target_hist.get("findings", []))
            if 0 <= finding_idx < len(findings):
                cur_status = findings[finding_idx].get("status", "Open")
                new_status = "Closed" if cur_status == "Open" else "Open"
                findings[finding_idx]["status"] = new_status
                target_hist["findings"] = findings

                # Update ke Supabase
                client = get_supabase()
                if client:
                    client.table("audit_sessions").update({"findings": findings}).in_("id", [audit_id]).execute()

                # Refresh state lokal
                self.auditor_history_list.set(histories)
                self.auditor_selected_detail.set(target_hist)

                return True, f"Status temuan berhasil diubah menjadi '{new_status}'!"
            return False, "Indeks temuan tidak valid!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal update status temuan: {str(e)}"

    # LOGIKA WAREHOUSE ACTIVITY MONITOR (SAP LL01)
    # ==========================================================================
    def load_ll01_data_from_supabase(self):
        """Menarik antrean barang transit dari Supabase & menghitung aging secara otomatis"""
        try:
            client = get_supabase()
            if not client:
                return False, "Koneksi Supabase gagal!"

            res = client.table("jezpro_waiting_staging") \
                        .select("*") \
                        .order("scanned_at", desc=True) \
                        .execute()

            if not res or not res.data:
                self.ll01_data_list.set([])
                self.ll01_last_sync.set(datetime.now().strftime("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S") + " WIB")
                return True, "Data di Supabase masih kosong atau antrean bersih!"

            df = pd.DataFrame(res.data)

            # 👇 TAMBAHKAN / PERBARUI BLOK INI (MAPPING 9 CABANG LENGKAP) 👇
            STORE_ID_MAP = {
                3: "JEZ SURABAYA",
                5: "JEZ KEDIRI",            # 🌟 ID Resmi: 5
                2: "JEZ MALANG",
                40: "JEZ JEMBER",
                8: "JEZ SIDOARJO",
                53: "JEZ SEMARANG",
                55: "HUB JAKARTA",          # 🌟 ID Resmi: 55
                30: "ONLINE HUB SURABAYA",  # 🌟 ID Resmi: 30
                20: "ONLINE HUB MALANG"     # 🌟 ID Resmi: 20
            }
            if 'store_id' in df.columns:
                df['branch'] = df['store_id'].map(STORE_ID_MAP).fillna("-")
                df['store_name'] = df['branch']
            else:
                df['branch'] = "-"
                df['store_name'] = "-"
            # 👆 ========================================================= 👆

            # Hitung Aging Jam & Menit
            if not df.empty and 'scanned_at' in df.columns:
                df['dt_scanned'] = pd.to_datetime(df['scanned_at'], errors='coerce')
                # Lokalisasi Waktu ke WIB
                now = pd.Timestamp.now(tz='Asia/Jakarta')
                
                def calc_aging(scanned_dt):
                    if pd.isna(scanned_dt):
                        return 0.0, "0m", "NORMAL"
                    if scanned_dt.tzinfo is None:
                        scanned_dt = scanned_dt.tz_localize('UTC').tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')
                    else:
                        scanned_dt = scanned_dt.tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')

                    diff_sec = (now - scanned_dt).total_seconds()
                    diff_hours = max(0.0, round(diff_sec / 3600.0, 1))
                    
                    # Format teks display durasi
                    hrs = int(diff_sec // 3600)
                    mins = int((diff_sec % 3600) // 60)
                    dur_str = f"{hrs}j {mins}m" if hrs > 0 else f"{mins}m"
                    
                    # Flagging Status Kritis LL01 (> 2 jam = CRITICAL)
                    status = "CRITICAL (>2 JAM)" if diff_hours >= 2.0 else "NORMAL"
                    return diff_hours, dur_str, status

                res_aging = [calc_aging(t) for t in df['dt_scanned']]
                df['aging_hours'] = [x[0] for x in res_aging]
                df['durasi_aging'] = [x[1] for x in res_aging]
                df['ll01_status'] = [x[2] for x in res_aging]

                # Format string tanggal cantik untuk tabel
                df['waktu_scan_str'] = df['dt_scanned'].dt.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M')
            
            self.ll01_data_list.set(df.to_dict(orient="records"))
            self.ll01_last_sync.set(datetime.now().strftime("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S") + " WIB")
            return True, f"Berhasil memuat {len(df)} item antrean staging dari Supabase."
        except Exception as e:
            print("Gagal load LL01 Supabase:", e)
            return False, f"Terjadi kesalahan: {str(e)}"

    # Helper Filter Tanggal & Note Universal
    def _match_date_and_note(self, dt_str, note_str, tgl_start, tgl_end, note_query):
        # 1. Filter Tanggal
        if tgl_start or tgl_end:
            try:
                clean_dt = str(dt_str)[:10].replace('/', '-')
                # Normalisasi format DD-MM-YYYY ke YYYY-MM-DD
                parts = clean_dt.split('-')
                if len(parts) == 3 and len(parts[0]) == 2:
                    clean_dt = f"{parts[2]}-{parts[1]}-{parts[0]}"
                
                if tgl_start and clean_dt < tgl_start:
                    return False
                if tgl_end and clean_dt > tgl_end:
                    return False
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 2. Filter Note / Keterangan
        if note_query and note_query.strip():
            q = note_query.strip().upper()
            if q not in str(note_str).upper():
                return False

        return True

    # Helper Pencocokan Filter Global (Store, Tanggal, & Note)
    def _match_global_filter(self, row_date, row_store_text, row_note_text):
        store_f = self.ll01_global_store()
        t_start = self.ll01_global_tgl_start()
        t_end = self.ll01_global_tgl_end()
        note_q = self.ll01_global_note()

        # 1. Filter Store / Cabang
        if store_f != "SEMUA":
            sf_clean = store_f.replace("JEZ ", "").strip().upper()
            rs_clean = str(row_store_text).strip().upper()
            if sf_clean not in rs_clean and rs_clean not in sf_clean:
                return False

        # 2. Filter Tanggal
        if t_start or t_end:
            try:
                clean_dt = str(row_date)[:10].replace('/', '-')
                parts = clean_dt.split('-')
                if len(parts) == 3 and len(parts[0]) == 2:
                    clean_dt = f"{parts[2]}-{parts[1]}-{parts[0]}"
                if t_start and clean_dt < t_start: return False
                if t_end and clean_dt > t_end: return False
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 3. Filter Note / Query Pencarian
        if note_q and note_q.strip():
            if note_q.strip().upper() not in str(row_note_text).strip().upper():
                return False

        return True

    # ==========================================================================
    def load_special_buffer_stock_from_supabase(self):
        """Menarik seluruh data stock dari table 'stock_live_cache' dan memfilter BIN transit/buffer"""
        try:
            import json
            client = get_supabase()
            if not client:
                return False, "Koneksi ke Supabase gagal!"

            res = client.table("stock_live_cache").select("*").execute()
            if not res or not res.data:
                self.ll01_special_stock_list.set([])
                return True, "Data stock_live_cache kosong di Supabase."

            def extract_field(item_dict, candidates, default=""):
                for c in candidates:
                    if c in item_dict and item_dict[c] is not None:
                        return item_dict[c]
                return default

            # 🌟 TAMBAHKAN KATA KUNCI "GAGAL QC", "QC", DAN "REFUND"
            target_keywords = ["KARANTINA", "INB", "PUTAWAY", "OUT", "GAGAL QC", "QC", "REFUND"]
            matched_records = []

            for row in res.data:
                branch_name = row.get("branch", "-")
                stock_raw = row.get("stock_data", [])

                if isinstance(stock_raw, str):
                    try:
                        stock_items = json.loads(stock_raw)
                    except Exception:
                        stock_items = []
                elif isinstance(stock_raw, list):
                    stock_items = stock_raw
                else:
                    stock_items = []

                for it in stock_items:
                    if not isinstance(it, dict):
                        continue

                    bin_val = str(extract_field(it, ["BIN", "bin", "lokasi", "LOKASI", "Bin Code", "BIN CODE"], "")).strip().upper()
                    if not bin_val:
                        continue

                    # Klasifikasi tipe buffer
                    matched_types = []
                    if "KARANTINA" in bin_val:
                        matched_types.append("KARANTINA")
                    if "INB" in bin_val or "INBOUND" in bin_val:
                        matched_types.append("INBOUND")
                    if "PUTAWAY" in bin_val:
                        matched_types.append("PUTAWAY")
                    if "OUT" in bin_val or "OUTBOUND" in bin_val:
                        matched_types.append("OUT")
                    # 🌟 DETEKSI BIN GAGAL QC & REFUND
                    if "GAGAL QC" in bin_val or "QC" in bin_val:
                        matched_types.append("GAGAL QC")
                    if "REFUND" in bin_val:
                        matched_types.append("REFUND")

                    if matched_types:
                        qty_raw = extract_field(it, ["QTY SYSTEM", "QTY SYS", "QTY", "qty", "STOK", "QUANTITY", "stok", "Jumlah"], 0)
                        qty_val = safe_int(qty_raw, 0)

                        if qty_val > 0:
                            matched_records.append({
                                "branch": branch_name,
                                "tipe_bin": " / ".join(matched_types),
                                "bin": bin_val,
                                "sku": str(extract_field(it, ["SKU", "sku", "BARCODE", "barcode", "item_code", "Item Code"], "-")).strip().upper(),
                                "item_name": str(extract_field(it, ["ITEM NAME", "item_name", "ARTIKEL", "artikel", "DESCRIPTION", "Description", "NAMA BARANG"], "-")).strip(),
                                "brand": str(extract_field(it, ["BRAND", "brand", "MERK", "merk"], "-")).strip().upper(),
                                "variant": str(extract_field(it, ["VARIANT", "variant", "SIZE", "size", "UKURAN"], "-")).strip().upper(),
                                "sub_kategori": str(extract_field(it, ["SUB KATEGORI", "sub_kategori", "CATEGORY", "category"], "-")).strip().upper(),
                                "qty": qty_val
                            })

            self.ll01_special_stock_list.set(matched_records)
            return True, f"Berhasil memuat {len(matched_records):,} baris stok buffer/transit."
        except Exception as e:
            print("Gagal load buffer stock:", e)
            return False, f"Terjadi kesalahan: {str(e)}"

    # --- METODE COMPLIANCE AUDIT ENGINE ---
    def get_compliance_scores(self):
        items = self.comp_audit_checklist()
        total_maks = 0.0
        total_diraih = 0.0
        
        for it in items:
            h = str(it.get("hasil", "Sesuai")).strip().upper()
            b = float(it.get("bobot", 1))
            if h == "N/A":
                continue
            total_maks += b * 1.0
            if h == "SESUAI":
                total_diraih += b * 1.0
            elif "MINOR" in h:
                total_diraih += b * 0.5
            elif "MAYOR" in h:
                total_diraih += b * 0.0

        pct = (total_diraih / total_maks * 100.0) if total_maks > 0 else 0.0
        
        if pct >= 90.0:
            grade = "Sangat Baik"
        elif pct >= 80.0:
            grade = "Baik"
        elif pct >= 70.0:
            grade = "Perlu Perbaikan"
        else:
            grade = "Kritis"
            
        passed = pct >= 80.0
        return total_maks, total_diraih, pct, grade, passed

    def import_filled_compliance_excel(self, file_info):
        try:
            df = load_data_from_info(file_info)
            if df.empty or df.shape[1] < 5:
                return False, "File Excel tidak sesuai format standar WH-AUD-001!"
            
            cur_items = list(self.comp_audit_checklist())
            item_map = {x["id"].upper(): idx for idx, x in enumerate(cur_items)}
            
            # Cari kolom ID dan Hasil
            c_id = None
            c_hasil = None
            c_cat = None
            for idx_c, col in enumerate(df.columns):
                c_str = str(col).strip().upper()
                if "ID" in c_str: c_id = idx_c
                elif "HASIL" in c_str: c_hasil = idx_c
                elif any(k in c_str for k in ["BUKTI", "CATATAN", "PENGAMATAN"]): c_cat = idx_c

            if c_id is None or c_hasil is None:
                c_id = 1
                c_hasil = 4
                c_cat = 8 if df.shape[1] > 8 else -1

            updated = 0
            for _, r in df.iterrows():
                row_id = str(r.iloc[c_id]).strip().upper()
                if row_id in item_map:
                    val_hasil = str(r.iloc[c_hasil]).strip()
                    val_cat = str(r.iloc[c_cat]).strip() if c_cat != -1 and not pd.isna(r.iloc[c_cat]) else ""
                    
                    if val_hasil.lower() != "nan" and val_hasil != "":
                        idx = item_map[row_id]
                        cur_items[idx]["hasil"] = val_hasil
                        if val_cat:
                            cur_items[idx]["catatan"] = val_cat
                        updated += 1

            self.comp_audit_checklist.set(cur_items)
            return True, f"Berhasil sinkronisasi {updated} butir kriteria kepatuhan dari Excel!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal membaca file: {str(e)}"

    def get_stock_cache_lookup(self):
        """Ambil data master dari Supabase tabel stock_live_cache untuk nama artikel & harga beli"""
        lookup = {}
        try:
            client = get_supabase()
            if not client: return lookup
            res = client.table("stock_live_cache").select("*").execute()
            if res and res.data:
                for row in res.data:
                    s_data = row.get("stock_data", [])
                    if isinstance(s_data, list):
                        for it in s_data:
                            if not isinstance(it, dict): continue
                            sku_k = str(it.get("SKU", it.get("sku", it.get("BARCODE", "")))).split('.')[0].strip().upper()
                            if not sku_k: continue
                            name_v = str(it.get("ITEM NAME", it.get("item_name", it.get("ARTIKEL", "-")))).strip()
                            cogs_v = safe_int(it.get("HARGA BELI", it.get("Harga Beli", it.get("cogs", 0))), 0)
                            if sku_k not in lookup or lookup[sku_k]["harga_beli"] == 0:
                                lookup[sku_k] = {"item_name": name_v, "harga_beli": cogs_v}
        except Exception as e:
            print("Gagal load stock_live_cache:", e)
        return lookup

    def sync_markom_event_requests(self, file_source=None, silent=False):
        """
        DIPERBAIKI: Langsung memanggil skrip scraping Google Sheet secara aktif
        saat tombol di Shiny diklik!
        """
        try:
            # Impor dan jalankan fungsi sync langsung dari scraper
            from sync_markom import run_sync
            succ, msg = run_sync()
            # Muat ulang data terbaru dari Supabase ke state Shiny
            self.load_memo_data()

        except Exception as e:

            print("Gagal direct run scraper, fallback load Supabase:", e)

    def load_memo_data(self):
        """
        DIPERBAIKI:
        1. Memo status DONE TIDAK dimasukkan ke Tab 1
        2. Pengurutan TERBARU di atas berdasarkan timestamp jam, menit, detik
        """
        try:
            import json
            import re
            client = get_supabase()
            if client:
                res = client.table("memo_pengajuan").select("*").order("tanggal", desc=True).execute()
                if res and hasattr(res, 'data') and res.data:
                    sanitized_memos = []
                    all_scraped_items = []

                    for m in res.data:
                        items = m.get("items", [])
                        if isinstance(items, str):
                            try:
                                items = json.loads(items)
                            except Exception:
                                items = []
                        m["items"] = items
                        sanitized_memos.append(m)

                        # 🌟 SOLUSI POIN 2: Jika status memo SUDAH DONE, JANGAN masukkan ke Tab 1!
                        is_done = str(m.get("status_adj", "")).upper() == "DONE"
                        if is_done:
                            continue

                        # Masukkan item HANYA dari memo yang belum DONE
                        if isinstance(items, list):
                            for it in items:
                                it_entry = dict(it)
                                if "memo_id" not in it_entry:
                                    it_entry["memo_id"] = m.get("id", "-")
                                all_scraped_items.append(it_entry)

                    # 🌟 SOLUSI POIN 3: Urutkan item dari yang TERBARU ke TERLAMA
                    def get_item_sort_datetime(it):
                        raw_ts = str(it.get("tanggal", ""))
                        try:
                            return pd.to_datetime(raw_ts)
                        except Exception:
                            return pd.Timestamp.min

                    all_scraped_items.sort(key=get_item_sort_datetime, reverse=True)

                    self.memo_list.set(sanitized_memos)
                    self.memo_scraped_event_items.set(all_scraped_items)
                    self.memo_last_sync_time.set(datetime.now().strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M") + " WIB")
                else:
                    self.memo_list.set([])
                    self.memo_scraped_event_items.set([])
        except Exception as e:
            print("Supabase load memo error:", e)

    def delete_memo(self, memo_id: str):
        """Menghapus memo dari Supabase"""
        try:
            client = get_supabase()
            if client:
                client.table("memo_pengajuan").delete().in_("id", [memo_id]).execute()
            self.load_memo_data()
            return True, f"Memo {memo_id} berhasil dihapus!"
        except Exception as e:
            cur_list = [m for m in self.memo_list() if m.get("id") != memo_id]
            self.memo_list.set(cur_list)
            return True, f"Memo {memo_id} berhasil dihapus!"

    # LOGIKA WORKFLOW STATUS ADJUSTMENT MEMO (TAB 2 & TAB 3)
    # ==========================================================================
    def get_pending_memos(self):
        """Mengambil memo yang BELUM di-adjustment (Pending) sesuai filter tanggal"""
        memos = self.memo_list()
        start = str(self.memo_filter_tgl_start()).strip()
        end = str(self.memo_filter_tgl_end()).strip()

        res = []
        for m in memos:
            st = str(m.get("status_adj", "PENDING")).upper().strip()
            if st == "DONE":
                continue  # Lewati yang sudah selesai

            tgl = str(m.get("tanggal", ""))[:10]
            if start and tgl < start:
                continue
            if end and tgl > end:
                continue
            res.append(m)
        return res

    def get_done_memos(self):
        """Mengambil memo yang SUDAH di-adjustment (Done) sesuai filter tanggal"""
        memos = self.memo_list()
        start = str(self.memo_filter_tgl_start()).strip()
        end = str(self.memo_filter_tgl_end()).strip()

        res = []
        for m in memos:
            st = str(m.get("status_adj", "PENDING")).upper().strip()
            if st != "DONE":
                continue  # Hanya yang sudah selesai

            tgl = str(m.get("tanggal", ""))[:10]
            if start and tgl < start:
                continue
            if end and tgl > end:
                continue
            res.append(m)
        return res

    # ==========================================================================
    # WORKFLOW 2-TAHAP: REQUEST ADJUSTMENT -> DONE ADJUSTMENT
    # ==========================================================================
    def mark_memo_adjustment_requested(self, memo_id: str):
        """Tahap 1: Tandai REQUEST ADJUSTMENT dan aktifkan tombol DONE"""
        try:
            memos = list(self.memo_list())
            now_req = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
            for m in memos:
                if m.get("id") == memo_id:
                    m["status_adj"] = "REQUESTED"
                    m["requested_at"] = now_req
                    break

            client = get_supabase()
            if client:
                client.table("memo_pengajuan").update({
                    "status_adj": "REQUESTED",
                    "requested_at": now_req
                }).in_("id", [memo_id]).execute()

            self.memo_list.set(memos)
            return True, f"Memo {memo_id} berhasil diajukan (REQUEST ADJUSTMENT). Tombol DONE ADJUSTMENT sekarang aktif!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal request adjustment: {e}"

    def mark_memo_adjustment_done(self, memo_id: str):
        """Tahap 2: Selesaikan memo dan pindahkan ke Tab 3"""
        try:
            memos = list(self.memo_list())
            now_done = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
            for m in memos:
                if m.get("id") == memo_id:
                    m["status_adj"] = "DONE"
                    m["done_at"] = now_done
                    break

            client = get_supabase()
            if client:
                client.table("memo_pengajuan").update({
                    "status_adj": "DONE",
                    "done_at": now_done
                }).in_("id", [memo_id]).execute()

            self.memo_list.set(memos)
            return True, f"Memo {memo_id} telah SELESAI (DONE ADJUSTMENT) dan dipindahkan ke Tab 3!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal menyelesaikan memo: {e}"

    def revert_memo_adjustment(self, memo_id: str):
        """Kembalikan memo dari Tab 3 ke Tab 2 (Reset status)"""
        try:
            memos = list(self.memo_list())
            for m in memos:
                if m.get("id") == memo_id:
                    m["status_adj"] = "PENDING"
                    m["done_at"] = None
                    m["requested_at"] = None
                    break

            client = get_supabase()
            if client:
                client.table("memo_pengajuan").update({
                    "status_adj": "PENDING",
                    "done_at": None,
                    "requested_at": None
                }).in_("id", [memo_id]).execute()

            self.memo_list.set(memos)
            return True, f"Memo {memo_id} dikembalikan ke Tab 2 (Pending)!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal mengembalikan memo: {e}"


    def load_instock_daily_from_supabase(self):
        """Memuat antrean barang terbaru dari Supabase tanpa memanggil .limit()"""
        try:
            client = get_supabase()
            if not client:
                self.iv_processed.set(True)
                return False, "Koneksi ke Supabase gagal!"

            all_data = []

            # 1. Coba query berdasarkan tanggal hari ini (tanpa .limit())
            try:
                today_str = datetime.now(WIB).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                res = client.table("jezpro_instock_daily").select("*").eq("sync_date", today_str).execute()
                if res and hasattr(res, "data") and res.data:
                    all_data = res.data[:300]  # 👈 Batasi 300 data langsung di Python
            except Exception as e_eq:
                print("Query eq sync_date dilewati:", e_eq)

            # 2. Jika hari ini kosong atau gagal, ambil data tabel (tanpa .limit())
            if not all_data:
                try:
                    res_all = client.table("jezpro_instock_daily").select("*").execute()
                    if res_all and hasattr(res_all, "data") and res_all.data:
                        all_data = res_all.data[:300]  # 👈 Batasi 300 data langsung di Python
                except Exception as e_select:
                    print("Query fallback select gagal:", e_select)
                    self.iv_processed.set(True)
                    return False, f"Gagal query jezpro_instock_daily: {e_select}"

            if not all_data:
                self.iv_instock_data.set([])
                self.iv_done_data.set([])
                self.iv_tab1_pending.set([])
                self.iv_tab3_scanned.set([])
                self.iv_processed.set(True)
                return True, "Data di Supabase masih kosong."

            df_all = pd.DataFrame(all_data)
            
            # Pengurutan data terbaru di atas
            sort_cols = [c for c in ["created_at", "disappeared_at", "id"] if c in df_all.columns]
            if sort_cols:
                df_all = df_all.sort_values(by=sort_cols[0], ascending=False)

            all_data = df_all.to_dict(orient="records")
            now_jakarta = pd.Timestamp.now(tz='Asia/Jakarta')

            def format_to_wib_time(ts_val):
                if not ts_val or str(ts_val).strip() in ["", "-", "None", "nan"]: return "-"
                try:
                    dt = pd.to_datetime(ts_val)
                    if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.tz_localize('UTC').tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')
                    else: dt = dt.tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')
                    return dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                except Exception:
                    s = str(ts_val)
                    return s[11:19] if len(s) >= 19 else s

            def get_instock_diff_minutes(r):
                ts = r.get("disappeared_at") or r.get("created_at")
                if not ts or str(ts).strip() in ["", "-", "None", "nan"]: return 999999.0
                try:
                    dt = pd.to_datetime(ts)
                    if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.tz_localize('UTC').tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')
                    else: dt = dt.tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')
                    return max(0.0, (now_jakarta - dt).total_seconds() / 60.0)
                except Exception: return 999999.0

            need_setup_raw = []
            done_setup_raw = []
            for x in all_data:
                st = str(x.get("status", x.get("waiting_status", ""))).strip().upper()
                if "DONE" in st:
                    done_setup_raw.append(x)
                else:
                    need_setup_raw.append(x)

            done_ids = set(str(d.get("id")) for d in done_setup_raw if d.get("id"))
            filter_waktu_mode = self.iv_filter_waktu() if hasattr(self, "iv_filter_waktu") else "BARUSAN_5"

            valid_need_setup = []
            for r in need_setup_raw:
                r_id = str(r.get("id"))
                if r.get("setup_done_at") or (r_id and r_id in done_ids):
                    continue

                raw_bin = str(r.get("bin_code", r.get("bin", "-"))).replace("[", "").replace("]", "").strip().upper()
                bin_awal = raw_bin if raw_bin not in ["WAITING OFFLINE", "-", ""] else "STAGING INBOUND"

                if "TOKO" in bin_awal:
                    continue

                diff_mins = get_instock_diff_minutes(r)
                if filter_waktu_mode == "BARUSAN_5" and diff_mins > 5.0: continue
                elif filter_waktu_mode == "BARUSAN_15" and diff_mins > 15.0: continue
                elif filter_waktu_mode == "BARUSAN_30" and diff_mins > 30.0: continue

                valid_need_setup.append(r)

            self.iv_tab1_pending.set(valid_need_setup)
            self.iv_tab3_scanned.set([])
            self.iv_done_data.set(done_setup_raw)

            self._refresh_iv_dataframes_from_lists()

            # Generate Tab 2 (Done Setup)
            done_records = []
            for r in done_setup_raw:
                q_done = safe_int(r.get("qty", 1), 1)
                done_time = format_to_wib_time(r.get("setup_done_at"))
                dis_time = format_to_wib_time(r.get("disappeared_at"))
                sku_clean = str(r.get("barcode_sku") or r.get("sku") or r.get("SKU") or "-").split('.')[0].strip().upper()

                done_records.append({
                    "JAM REQUEST": dis_time,
                    "JAM MUTASI SELESAI": done_time,
                    "SKU": sku_clean,
                    "NAMA ARTIKEL": str(r.get("article_name", "-")),
                    "BIN AWAL": str(r.get("bin_code", r.get("bin", "-"))).replace("[", "").replace("]", "").strip().upper(),
                    "BIN TUJUAN": "GL1-INSTOCK",
                    "QUANTITY": q_done,
                    "STATUS": "✅ TERVERIFIKASI JEZPRO"
                })

            df_done = pd.DataFrame(done_records)
            tot_done = sum(safe_int(x.get("qty", 1), 1) for x in done_setup_raw)
            self.iv_total_done_qty.set(tot_done)
            self._raw_df_iv_done = df_done
            self.df_iv_done_headers.set(df_done.columns.tolist() if not df_done.empty else [])
            self.df_iv_done_rows.set(df_done.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist() if not df_done.empty else [])

            self.iv_processed.set(True)
            return True, f"Sinkronisasi berhasil! ({len(valid_need_setup)} Butuh Setup, {len(done_setup_raw)} Selesai)"
        except Exception as e:
            print("Error load_instock_daily_from_supabase:", e)
            self.iv_processed.set(True)
            return False, f"Gagal memuat data: {e}"

            if not ts or str(ts).strip() in ["", "-", "None", "nan"]: return 999999.0

                dt = pd.to_datetime(ts)
                if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.tz_localize('UTC').tz_convert('Asia/Jakarta')

    def process_refill_shelving(self, file_info):
        try:
            if not file_info:
                return False, "File Stock wajib diupload!"

            df = load_data_from_info(file_info)
            if df.empty:
                return False, "File yang diupload kosong!"

            df.columns = [str(c).strip().upper() for c in df.columns]

            def get_flexible_col(exact_names, fallback_kws, default_idx):
                for name in exact_names:
                    if name.upper() in df.columns:
                        return df[name.upper()]
                for kw in fallback_kws:
                    for col in df.columns:
                        if kw.upper() in col:
                            return df[col]
                if df.shape[1] > default_idx:
                    return df.iloc[:, default_idx]
                return df.iloc[:, 0]

            col_b = get_flexible_col(['BIN', 'LOKASI', 'RAK', 'BIN_CODE'], ['BIN', 'LOKASI'], 1 if df.shape[1] > 1 else 0)
            col_s = get_flexible_col(['SKU', 'BARCODE', 'ITEM CODE', 'BARCODE_SKU'], ['SKU', 'BARCODE'], 2 if df.shape[1] > 2 else 0)
            col_e = get_flexible_col(['ITEM NAME', 'ITEM_NAME', 'ARTIKEL', 'DESCRIPTION', 'NAMA BARANG'], ['ITEM', 'NAMA', 'ARTIKEL'], 4 if df.shape[1] > 4 else 0)
            col_j = get_flexible_col(['QTY SYSTEM', 'QTY_SYSTEM', 'QTY', 'QUANTITY', 'STOK'], ['QTY', 'STOK', 'QUANTITY'], 9 if df.shape[1] > 9 else (df.shape[1]-1))

            df_clean = pd.DataFrame({
                'BIN': pd.Series(col_b).fillna('').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper(),
                'SKU': pd.Series(col_s).fillna('').astype(str).str.split('.').str[0].str.strip().str.upper(),
                'ITEM_NAME': pd.Series(col_e).fillna('-').astype(str).str.strip(),
                'QTY_NUM': pd.to_numeric(pd.Series(col_j), errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
            })

            df_clean = df_clean[(df_clean['SKU'] != '') & (df_clean['SKU'] != 'NAN') & (df_clean['BIN'] != '')].copy()

            if df_clean.empty:
                return False, "Tidak ada data valid yang dapat diproses dari file tersebut."

            # Deteksi BIN yang mengandung kata 'KL' (Koli / Reserve)
            df_clean['IS_KL'] = df_clean['BIN'].str.contains('KL', na=False, case=False)

            # 🌟 AMBIL SEMUA SKU UNIK YANG ADA DI KOLI (KL DENGAN QTY > 0)
            kl_skus_df = df_clean[df_clean['IS_KL'] & (df_clean['QTY_NUM'] > 0)]
            unique_kl_skus = kl_skus_df['SKU'].unique()
            total_kl_count = len(unique_kl_skus)

            refill_records = []
            sku_needing_refill = set()

            for sku, group in df_clean.groupby('SKU'):
                item_name = group['ITEM_NAME'].iloc[0]
                
                kl_group = group[group['IS_KL']].copy()
                shelving_group = group[~group['IS_KL']].copy()

                total_kl_sku_qty = int(kl_group['QTY_NUM'].sum())
                total_shelving_qty_sku = int(shelving_group['QTY_NUM'].sum())

                # Kondisi: Shelving qty 0 atau 1-3, dan total stock di KL > 0 (Perlu Refill)
                if (total_shelving_qty_sku == 0 or (1 <= total_shelving_qty_sku <= 3)) and total_kl_sku_qty > 0:
                    sku_needing_refill.add(sku)
                    target_pick = max(1, int(round(total_kl_sku_qty * 0.8)))
                    remaining_need = target_pick

                    kl_sorted = kl_group.sort_values(by='QTY_NUM', ascending=False)

                    for _, kl_row in kl_sorted.iterrows():
                        if remaining_need <= 0:
                            break
                        bin_ambil = kl_row['BIN']
                        bin_qty = int(kl_row['QTY_NUM'])
                        if bin_qty <= 0:
                            continue

                        take = min(remaining_need, bin_qty)
                        refill_records.append({
                            "BIN AMBIL": bin_ambil,
                            "SKU": sku,
                            "ITEM NAME": item_name,
                            "QTY SHELVING": total_shelving_qty_sku,
                            "QTY PICK": take
                        })
                        remaining_need -= take

        # 🌟 HITUNG PERSENTASE (116 / 144 = 80.6% alias 81%)
            if total_kl_count > 0:
                missing_count = len([s for s in unique_kl_skus if s in sku_needing_refill])
                val_pct = (missing_count / total_kl_count) * 100.0   # 👈 INI YANG MENGHASILKAN 80.6% / 81%!
            else:
                val_pct = 0.0

            df_res = pd.DataFrame(refill_records) if refill_records else pd.DataFrame(columns=["BIN AMBIL", "SKU", "ITEM NAME", "QTY SHELVING", "QTY PICK"])

            unique_sku_refill = len(sku_needing_refill)
            total_pick_val = int(df_res['QTY PICK'].sum()) if not df_res.empty else 0

            # Set State
            self.rs_total_sku.set(unique_sku_refill)
            self.rs_total_pick.set(total_pick_val)
            self.rs_shelving_pct.set(val_pct)  # 🌟 Masukkan val_pct (Hasilnya pasti 80.6% / 81%) # 🌟 Masukkan nilai persentase on shelving  # 🌟 Pastikan variabel ini yang dimasukkan (80.6%)

            self._raw_df_rs = df_res.copy()
            self.df_rs_headers.set(df_res.columns.tolist() if not df_res.empty else [])
            self.df_rs_rows.set(df_res.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist() if not df_res.empty else [])
            self.rs_processed.set(True)

            return True, f"Refill Shelving Berhasil Dihitung! Ditemukan {len(df_res)} baris instruksi ambil."
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            return False, f"Gagal memproses Refill Shelving: {e}"

    def load_targets_data(self):
        """Memuat target dan progress harian dari Supabase sesuai filter divisi, week, bulan, tahun"""
        try:
            client = get_supabase()
            divisi = self.target_divisi()
            week = self.target_week()
            month = self.target_month()
            year = safe_int(self.target_year(), 2026)

            if not client:
                return False, "Koneksi Supabase gagal!"

            # 1. Tarik Master Target
            res_t = client.table("warehouse_targets").select("*") \
                          .eq("sub_divisi", divisi) \
                          .eq("target_week", week) \
                          .eq("target_month", month) \
                          .eq("target_year", year) \
                          .order("id", desc=False).execute()

            targets = res_t.data if res_t and res_t.data else []
            self.target_items_list.set(targets)

            # 2. Tarik Progress Harian untuk target-target tersebut
            if targets:
                target_ids = [t["id"] for t in targets]
                res_p = client.table("warehouse_target_daily_progress").select("*") \
                              .in_("target_id", target_ids).execute()
                
                daily_rows = res_p.data if res_p and res_p.data else []
                d_map = {}
                for r in daily_rows:
                    key = f"{r['target_id']}_{r['day_num']}"
                    d_map[key] = {
                        "achievement": r.get("achievement_pct", 0),
                        "note": r.get("note", ""),
                        "deadline": r.get("deadline_days", "-"),
                        "justifikasi": r.get("justifikasi_status", "-")
                    }
                self.target_daily_map.set(d_map)
            else:
                self.target_daily_map.set({})

            return True, f"Berhasil memuat {len(targets)} target."
        except Exception as e:
            print("Gagal load target:", e)
            return False, str(e)

    def save_target_daily_progress(self, progress_payload: list):
        """Menyimpan progress harian: Cek -> Jika sudah ada di-UPDATE, jika belum ada di-INSERT. TANPA DELETE."""
        try:
            client = get_supabase()
            if not client:
                return False, "Koneksi Supabase gagal!"

            if not progress_payload:
                return True, "Tidak ada data progress yang dikirim."

            # 1. Kumpulkan seluruh target_id yang sedang diproses
            target_ids = list(set([
                safe_int(r.get("target_id")) 
                for r in progress_payload 
                if r.get("target_id") is not None
            ]))

            # 2. Ambil data yang sudah ada di Supabase untuk mencatat ID barisnya (tanpa menghapus apa pun)
            existing_rows_map = {}
            if target_ids:
                try:
                    res_existing = client.table("warehouse_target_daily_progress").select("*").in_("target_id", target_ids).execute()
                except Exception:
                    res_existing = client.table("warehouse_target_daily_progress").select("*").in_("target_id", [str(x) for x in target_ids]).execute()

                if res_existing and hasattr(res_existing, 'data') and res_existing.data:
                    for row in res_existing.data:
                        t_id = safe_int(row.get("target_id"))
                        d_num = safe_int(row.get("day_num"))
                        # Petakan (target_id, day_num) -> id database
                        existing_rows_map[(t_id, d_num)] = row.get("id")

            # 3. Proses penyimpanan: UPDATE jika sudah ada, INSERT jika baru
            for item in progress_payload:
                t_id = safe_int(item.get("target_id"))
                d_num = safe_int(item.get("day_num"))
                key = (t_id, d_num)

                row_payload = {
                    "target_id": t_id,
                    "day_num": d_num,
                    "achievement_pct": safe_int(item.get("achievement_pct", 0)),
                    "note": str(item.get("note", "")),
                    "deadline_days": str(item.get("deadline_days", "-")),
                    "justifikasi_status": str(item.get("justifikasi_status", "-"))
                }

                if key in existing_rows_map:
                    # ✅ JIKA SUDAH ADA: HANYA UPDATE NILAINYA (TIDAK DIHAPUS)
                    db_id = existing_rows_map[key]
                    try:
                        client.table("warehouse_target_daily_progress").update(row_payload).eq("id", db_id).execute()
                    except Exception:
                        client.table("warehouse_target_daily_progress").update(row_payload).in_("id", [db_id]).execute()
                else:
                    # ✅ JIKA BELUM ADA: TAMBAHKAN BARIS BARU
                    client.table("warehouse_target_daily_progress").insert(row_payload).execute()

            # 4. Refresh tampilan data
            self.load_targets_data()
            return True, "✅ Progress pencapaian berhasil disimpan (Data lama diperbarui tanpa dihapus)!"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Gagal menyimpan progress: {e}"

    def get_target_metrics_summary(self):
        """
        Kalkulasi Metrik Tab 3:
        - Tiap hari memegang bobot rata (1/7 dari target).
        - Jika semua hari 100% -> Hasil 100%.
        - Jika ada hari yang < 100% (Unconfirmed) -> Progress terpotong proporsional.
        - Jika status CONFIRMED -> Target terlindungi (tetap dihitung 100%).
        """
        targets = self.target_items_list()
        daily_map = self.target_daily_map()
        total_targets = len(targets)

        if total_targets == 0:
            return {
                "total_targets": 0,
                "avg_achievement_pct": 100.0,
                "confirmed_count": 0,
                "unconfirmed_count": 0,
                "total_potongan_pct": 0.0
            }

        confirmed_count = 0
        unconfirmed_count = 0
        total_effective_pct = 0.0
        total_days = total_targets * 7

        for t in targets:
            t_id = t["id"]
            for d in range(1, 8):
                key = f"{t_id}_{d}"
                entry = daily_map.get(key, {})

                raw_achieve = entry.get("achievement")
                # Default hari yang belum diubah adalah 100%
                achieve = safe_int(raw_achieve, 100) if raw_achieve is not None else 100
                just = str(entry.get("justifikasi", "-")).strip().upper()

                is_unconf = ("UNCONFIRMED" in just)
                is_conf = ("CONFIRMED" in just and not is_unconf)

                # Jika ada kendala tapi alasan terkonfirmasi (misal server down / mati lampu)
                if is_conf and achieve < 100:
                    confirmed_count += 1
                    effective = 100.0  # Dilindungi, tetap dihitung 100%
                elif is_unconf and achieve < 100:
                    unconfirmed_count += 1
                    effective = float(achieve)  # Realita lapangan (misal 70%)
                else:
                    effective = float(achieve)

                total_effective_pct += effective

        # Rata-rata pencapaian dari hari ke-1 sampai hari ke-7
        final_score = round(total_effective_pct / total_days, 1) if total_days > 0 else 100.0
        total_potongan = round(100.0 - final_score, 1)

        return {
            "total_targets": total_targets,
            "avg_achievement_pct": final_score,
            "confirmed_count": confirmed_count,
            "unconfirmed_count": unconfirmed_count,
            "total_potongan_pct": total_potongan
        }

    # LOGIKA FDR CONTROLLER (URGENSI MANIFEST SURABAYA)
    # ==========================================================================
    def process_fdr_controller(self, file_info):
        try:
            if not file_info:
                return False, "File manifest/order wajib diupload!"

            df_raw = load_data_from_info(file_info)
            if df_raw.empty:
                return False, "File yang diupload kosong!"

            # Minimal 14 kolom (A s/d N)
            if df_raw.shape[1] < 14:
                return False, f"File hanya memiliki {df_raw.shape[1]} kolom! Minimal membutuhkan 14 kolom (hingga Kolom N)."

            df = df_raw.copy()

            # Mapping Kolom sesuai instruksi:
            # Kolom C (Index 2) = Order Number
            # Kolom D (Index 3) = Resi
            # Kolom E (Index 4) = Warehouse
            # Kolom G (Index 6) = Order Date Create
            # Kolom L (Index 11) = Status
            # Kolom N (Index 13) = Target Time FDR
            col_order = df.columns[2]
            col_resi = df.columns[3]
            col_wh = df.columns[4]
            col_create = df.columns[6]
            col_status = df.columns[11]
            col_target_fdr = df.columns[13]

            # 1. Bersihkan Data Dasar
            df['ORDER_NO'] = df[col_order].fillna('-').astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)
            df['RESI'] = df[col_resi].fillna('-').astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)
            df['WAREHOUSE'] = df[col_wh].fillna('').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
            df['STATUS'] = df[col_status].fillna('').astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()

            # 2. FILTER: Warehouse Surabaya & Status selain DONE dan CANCEL
            mask_wh = df['WAREHOUSE'].str.contains('SURABAYA', na=False)
            mask_status = ~df['STATUS'].isin(['DONE', 'CANCEL']) & (df['STATUS'] != '')

            df_filtered = df[mask_wh & mask_status].copy()

            if df_filtered.empty:
                return False, "Tidak ditemukan order untuk cabang SURABAYA dengan status selain DONE dan CANCEL."

            # 3. Parsing Datetime Waktu Sekarang (WIB Jakarta)
            now_wib = pd.Timestamp.now(tz='Asia/Jakarta').tz_localize(None)

            # 4. Parsing Target Time FDR (Kolom N) dan Order Date Create (Kolom G)
            df_filtered['DT_CREATE'] = pd.to_datetime(df_filtered[col_create], errors='coerce')
            df_filtered['DT_TARGET'] = pd.to_datetime(df_filtered[col_target_fdr], errors='coerce')

            records = []
            c_overdue = 0
            c_critical = 0
            c_warning = 0
            c_normal = 0

            for _, row in df_filtered.iterrows():
                target_dt = row['DT_TARGET']
                create_dt = row['DT_CREATE']

                create_str = create_dt.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') if pd.notna(create_dt) else str(row[col_create])
                target_str = target_dt.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') if pd.notna(target_dt) else str(row[col_target_fdr])

                if pd.notna(target_dt):
                    # Selisih waktu dalam menit (target - sekarang)
                    diff_mins = (target_dt - now_wib).total_seconds() / 60.0

                    if diff_mins < 0:
                        mins_passed = int(abs(diff_mins))
                        hrs_passed = mins_passed // 60
                        m_rem = mins_passed % 60
                        time_display = f"Lewat {hrs_passed}j {m_rem}m" if hrs_passed > 0 else f"Lewat {m_rem}m"
                        urgency_rank = 1
                        urgency_label = "🚨 OVERDUE / EXPIRED"
                        c_overdue += 1
                    elif diff_mins <= 60:
                        time_display = f"Sisa {int(diff_mins)} menit"
                        urgency_rank = 2
                        urgency_label = "🔥 KRITIS (< 1 JAM)"
                        c_critical += 1
                    elif diff_mins <= 180:
                        hrs = int(diff_mins // 60)
                        m_rem = int(diff_mins % 60)
                        time_display = f"Sisa {hrs}j {m_rem}m"
                        urgency_rank = 3
                        urgency_label = "⚠️ MENENGAH (1-3 JAM)"
                        c_warning += 1
                    else:
                        hrs = int(diff_mins // 60)
                        m_rem = int(diff_mins % 60)
                        time_display = f"Sisa {hrs}j {m_rem}m"
                        urgency_rank = 4
                        urgency_label = "🟢 NORMAL (> 3 JAM)"
                        c_normal += 1
                else:
                    diff_mins = 999999.0
                    time_display = "-"
                    urgency_rank = 5
                    urgency_label = "❓ TARGET TIDAK VALID"

                records.append({
                    "URGENSI RANK": urgency_rank,
                    "TINGKAT URGENSI": urgency_label,
                    "SISA WAKTU DEADLINE": time_display,
                    "ORDER NUMBER": row['ORDER_NO'],
                    "NOMOR RESI": row['RESI'],
                    "WAREHOUSE": row['WAREHOUSE'],
                    "ORDER DATE CREATE": create_str,
                    "TARGET TIME FDR": target_str,
                    "STATUS": row['STATUS'],
                    "_diff_mins": diff_mins
                })

            df_result = pd.DataFrame(records)

            # Sort agar yang paling mendesak / paling mendekati deadline berada di paling atas
            df_result = df_result.sort_values(by=['_diff_mins', 'URGENSI RANK'], ascending=[True, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
            df_display = df_result.drop(columns=['URGENSI RANK', '_diff_mins'])

            # Set Reactive State
            self.fdr_total_order.set(len(df_display))
            self.fdr_overdue.set(c_overdue)
            self.fdr_critical.set(c_critical)
            self.fdr_warning.set(c_warning)
            self.fdr_normal.set(c_normal)

            self._raw_df_fdr = df_display.copy()
            self.df_fdr_headers.set(df_display.columns.tolist())
            self.df_fdr_rows.set(df_display.fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist())
            self.fdr_processed.set(True)

            return True, f"Berhasil memproses {len(df_display):,} order FDR untuk Surabaya!"
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            return False, f"Terjadi kesalahan saat memproses FDR: {str(e)}"
